notes: 2018_00_link.txt (January 2016 edition) differs from the 2018 edition (2018_01_faculty_handbook_2018.txt) only in visiting, collaborator and affiliate appointments, administrative titles, appeal procedures and table-of-contents page numbers; the leave, part-time and tenure-clock sections are identical.

Reference date 2018-02-22. The January 2018 Faculty Handbook (captured 2018-02-14) governs; the January 2016 edition is superseded and used for no evidence. The provost FMDA page is undated (captured 2018-02-14, in the reference year); the FMDA FAQ (dated July 23, 2015) and the provost family-needs guidelines (December 2014) are summaries/guidelines; FMDA terms are coded from the FMDA policy page, with FAQ details (definition of primary caregiver, repayment, dual-employee rule) noted as such.

No employer-paid parental or childbirth leave exists in the sources: pregnancy disability is treated as sick leave paid from the employee's own accrual (c1), followed by leave without pay granted on request for the rest of the disability (c2). FMLA (c4, c5) is unpaid; paid balances run concurrently.

The university FMLA policy states separate allotments of 12 work weeks of family leave and 12 of medical leave per calendar year; the statute grants a total of 12. Coded as two statutory components linked concurrent_with (not additive), flagged as a rule gap.

FMDA (c8) is coded negotiated: the member may request it and the duties are mutually agreed with the chair and approved by dean and provost; effort stays at 100% and the reduced duties are not specified (FAQ example: teaching release with more research).

Statutory floor: FMLA 12 workweeks (U7) applies; Iowa Code 216.6(2)(e) (up to 8 weeks unpaid pregnancy leave when leave is not available) is named in the sick-leave policy but not saved (statute_verified false).
Calendar: the Handbook refers to 'fall and spring semesters' and the FMDA is one semester; kind of term stated without length: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Birth parent chain: sick leave from own balance (c1, concurrent with FMLA medical leave c4, 12 workweeks) -> leave without pay for the rest of the disability (c2, consecutive_after c1; Iowa Code 216.6 leave c3 up to 8 weeks concurrent with c2); FMLA family leave c5 (12 workweeks) concurrent with c4; FMDA one semester (c8, negotiated) also_available with c5; medical LWOP c17 consecutive_after c1 (general provision; c2 governs for pregnancy).
Non-birth parent chain: FMLA family leave c5 (12 workweeks) -> FMDA one semester (c8) also_available; emergency leave c7 (5 days, own sick balance) unlinked.
